name: Silhouette Fashion Lace Interface Gloves
description:
Delicate, elbow-length gloves made from conductive lace that allows the wearer to interact with touch-sensitive surfaces and holographic interfaces through the fabric. The lace pattern conceals micro-capacitive threads that replicate the wearer's natural touch conductivity. Available in black, ivory, and deep crimson.

A Spire fashion staple that solves the social problem of wanting to look elegant while still being able to use your comm unit, access door panels, and manipulate holographic displays without removing your gloves.
functionality: Touch-through interface compatibility, full haptic conductivity
what_it_says: You refuse to choose between elegance and functionality because you can afford not to.
story_hooks: A pair of Lace Interface Gloves left at a gala contain micro-capacitive recordings of every surface their wearer touched that evening — including a secure terminal that shouldn't have been accessible.
related_entities: Ringo Corponation SlipThread MX-3 Urban Cable Micro-Mobility Rig

physical_description.visual_profile: Elegant, elongated silhouette extending from fingertips to mid-forearm. The lace creates an intricate, delicate appearance that reads as haute couture despite its functional technology. Drapes softly over the hand and wrist with subtle structure at the cuff.
physical_description.fit: Tailored to the hand contours with gentle compression at the wrist. The lace allows slight stretch and breathing room; sits snugly but not restrictively. Cuff sits just below the elbow with optional securing band.
physical_description.primary_material: Conductive synthetic lace composite with micro-capacitive thread integration. Appears as luxury fashion lace but functions as touch-interface fabric.
physical_description.texture: Delicate, intricate lace weave with visible filigree patterns. Smooth to touch despite the technical threadwork beneath. Subtle sheen from conductive elements caught in light.
physical_description.color_scheme: Available in three options: jet black with silver micro-thread highlights, ivory with gold accent threads, deep crimson with copper micro-capacitive veins visible in the weave.
physical_description.closures: None—slip-on design. Optional magnetic retention band at elbow for security.
distinctive_features: Micro-capacitive thread network woven throughout lace pattern
Fingertip reinforcement zones for precise haptic feedback
Barely-visible conductive pathways in the weave structure
Silhouette Fashion logo embroidered at wrist in matching thread
Seamless integration of fashion and interface technology
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1-2 luxury. Expensive enough to signal wealth; functional enough for daily corpo use.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corporate elite, high-end service sectors, corpo social events. Wearer signals sophistication, access to bleeding-edge tech, and the leisure to maintain delicate garments. Also favored by augmented individuals who want elegant hand coverings.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to well-maintained. Proper care extends lifespan; lace integrity is crucial to function. Minor wear shows at fingertips first from repeated interface contact.

Model's hand positioned mid-gesture, fingers delicately touching projected light particles. Dark metallic backdrop with soft neon blue and amber ambient lighting.
